what.water: open water: reservoirs, lakes, the bay
what.wetland: woody and emergent wetland, incl. the South Bay marsh
what.broadleaf: deciduous and mixed forest, incl. oak woodland
what.shrub: shrub and scrub, incl. coastal chaparral
what.barren: barren rock, sand and clay; unconsolidated shore

layout: row-major cell (j * w + i), then 8 family bytes
encoding: fraction of the cell that is that family, 255 = all of it
coverage: the eight bytes need not sum to 255. The remainder is the part of the cell NLCD does not cover — open Pacific beyond the L48 land boundary. A cell summing to 0 is NOT KNOWN and the reader keeps the elevation tint there rather than inventing a colour.

source.what: 30 m national land cover, fetched at 4x the surround cell grid and reduced to per-cell family fractions
source.classes_recovered: the WMS returns a styled image, so classes are recovered from colours using the colour map the SERVER publishes via GetStyles. Exact match only — a pixel matching no entry fails the run.
source.licence: USGS: USGS-authored or produced data and information are in the public domain

note: This is land cover, not land USE, and it is 2021 — it describes the region today and says nothing about any earlier year the map can be scrubbed to.
